crossRefs.note: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in…
Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their…

translations.web: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
translations.bsb: So they will lack food and water; they will be appalled at the sight of one another wasting away in their iniquity.
translations.kjv: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
translations.asv: that they may want bread and water, and be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
